default_inbound_policy.title: Default Inbound ACL Policy
default_inbound_policy.description: The default action applied to inbound traffic when no explicit rule matches. A default-allow posture is a direct exposure indicator.

any_source_rules_count.title: Rules Permitting Any Source Address
any_source_rules_count.description: Number of active inbound ACL rules that specify source address as 0.0.0.0/0 or 'any', allowing traffic from all untrusted sources.

stale_rules_present.title: Stale or Unreviewed ACL/Firewall Rules Present
stale_rules_present.description: Indicates whether the ruleset contains rules not reviewed within the policy review period, lacking business justification, or referencing decommissioned hosts/services. Applies to both ACL and firewall policy contexts.

internal_segments_directly_reachable.title: Internal Segments Directly Reachable from Untrusted Zone
internal_segments_directly_reachable.description: Indicates whether inbound ACL rules permit traffic from external/untrusted zones to reach internal network segments beyond DMZ, bypassing trust zone boundaries.

egress_acl_enforced.title: Egress ACL Enforced
egress_acl_enforced.description: Whether explicit outbound ACLs are applied at the perimeter boundary to restrict unauthorized outbound traffic from internal hosts.

domain_based_egress_filtering_enabled.title: Domain-Based Egress Filtering Enabled
domain_based_egress_filtering_enabled.description: Whether DNS/domain-based filtering is applied to outbound traffic to block connections to untrusted or unknown destinations.

egress_traffic_inspection_mode.title: Egress Traffic Inspection Mode
egress_traffic_inspection_mode.description: The depth of inspection applied to outbound traffic at the perimeter boundary, covering both inbound-to-internal and internal-to-external flows.

vpn_post_auth_segmentation_enforced.title: VPN Post-Authentication Segmentation Enforced
vpn_post_auth_segmentation_enforced.description: Indicates whether VPN-authenticated sessions are restricted to specific internal zones or network segments based on user/device identity, role, or policy.

vpn_accessible_internal_zone_count.title: Number of Internal Zones Accessible via VPN
vpn_accessible_internal_zone_count.description: The number of distinct internal trust zones reachable from a standard authenticated VPN session without additional access controls. A value greater than 1 indicates cross-zone trust propagation.

vpn_micro_segmentation_policy.title: VPN Micro-Segmentation Policy Enforcement
vpn_micro_segmentation_policy.description: The level of micro-segmentation or ZTNA policy applied to VPN sessions after authentication, determining how granularly lateral movement is constrained.

backend_zone_acl_enforced.title: Backend Zone ACL Enforced on Load Balancer
backend_zone_acl_enforced.description: Indicates whether the load balancer enforces zone-level ACLs restricting which sources and protocols can reach backend tiers, and whether backend systems accept connections exclusively from the load balancer.

firewall_policy_bypass_possible.title: Firewall Policy Bypass Possible via Load Balancer
firewall_policy_bypass_possible.description: Indicates whether traffic routed from the load balancer to backend tiers can reach backends without traversing the firewall inspection path, effectively collapsing DMZ segmentation.

protocol_validation_mode.title: Protocol Validation Mode
protocol_validation_mode.description: The level of protocol conformance validation applied to inbound traffic before forwarding to backend tiers or across zone boundaries.

shared_management_network.title: Shared Management Network/VLAN Across Boundary Devices
shared_management_network.description: Indicates whether the firewall, VPN gateway, and load balancer share a common out-of-band management network or management VLAN, and whether inter-device management ACLs are enforced to restrict lateral access between them.

inter_device_management_acl_enforced.title: Inter-Device Management ACL Enforced
inter_device_management_acl_enforced.description: Indicates whether ACLs or firewall rules restrict lateral access between boundary devices' management interfaces on the shared management plane.

management_plane_auth_method.title: Management Plane Authentication Method
management_plane_auth_method.description: The authentication mechanism used to access the management interfaces of boundary devices on the shared management network.

split_tunneling_enabled.title: Split Tunneling Enabled
split_tunneling_enabled.description: Indicates whether the VPN gateway policy permits split tunneling, allowing remote clients to simultaneously route traffic through the VPN tunnel and directly to the internet outside the VPN boundary.

vpn_client_traffic_inspection_enforced.title: VPN Client Traffic Inspection Enforced
vpn_client_traffic_inspection_enforced.description: Indicates whether all inbound traffic arriving from VPN clients is subject to boundary inspection before reaching internal zone resources, even when split tunneling is permitted.

vpn_client_subnet_segmentation.title: VPN Client Subnet Segmentation Level
vpn_client_subnet_segmentation.description: Describes how the VPN client address pool is segmented from internal backend zones. 'none' means clients are placed in the same zone as internal resources; 'partial' means basic ACL-based separation exists but no dedicated DMZ; 'full' means clients land in a dedicated inspection zone with enforced east-west controls.

inter_tier_segmentation_enforced.title: Inter-Tier Segmentation Enforced
inter_tier_segmentation_enforced.description: Whether explicit network segmentation rules are enforced between backend tiers within the ingress zone, preventing unrestricted east-west traffic. Encompasses both logical segmentation and whether tiers share a common network segment.

east_west_traffic_inspection_enabled.title: East-West Traffic Inspection Enabled
east_west_traffic_inspection_enabled.description: Whether lateral traffic between backend tier hosts within the ingress zone is subject to deep packet inspection, IDS/IPS, or equivalent inline security controls.

post_decryption_traffic_inspection_enabl.title: Post-Decryption Traffic Inspection Enabled
post_decryption_traffic_inspection_enabl.description: Indicates whether decrypted VPN traffic is inspected by a firewall or IDS/IPS before entering the internal network zone after VPN termination.

vpn_termination_zone_placement.title: VPN Termination Zone Placement
vpn_termination_zone_placement.description: Describes where the VPN gateway terminates traffic relative to inspection controls — whether traffic bypasses the firewall/IDS entirely, is placed in a DMZ where it is inspected, or terminates directly inside the trusted internal zone.

ids_ips_sensor_coverage_on_vpn_segment.title: IDS/IPS Sensor Coverage on VPN Decrypted Segment
ids_ips_sensor_coverage_on_vpn_segment.description: Indicates whether an IDS/IPS sensor is deployed inline or in monitoring mode on the network segment that carries post-decryption VPN traffic.

dpi_enabled_on_allowed_ports.title: Deep Packet Inspection Enabled on Allowed Ports
dpi_enabled_on_allowed_ports.description: Indicates whether deep packet inspection or application-layer filtering is enforced on ingress rules permitting commonly exploited ports such as 443 or 53, to verify traffic conforms to expected protocol.

allowed_ports_without_protocol_enforceme.title: Allowed Ports Lacking Protocol Enforcement
allowed_ports_without_protocol_enforceme.description: List of ingress-permitted port numbers that have no application-layer protocol enforcement and rely solely on port-based matching, enabling protocol tunneling.

stateful_inspection_symmetry_enforced.title: Stateful Inspection Symmetry Enforced
stateful_inspection_symmetry_enforced.description: Whether the load balancer or multi-homed firewall configuration ensures that request and response traffic always traverse the same stateful firewall instance for connection tracking.

firewall_state_synchronization_enabled.title: Firewall State Synchronization Enabled
firewall_state_synchronization_enabled.description: Whether connection state tables are synchronized across all firewall instances in the cluster or multi-homed deployment, so any instance can inspect return traffic even if routing is asymmetric.

asymmetric_routing_paths_present.title: Asymmetric Routing Paths Present
asymmetric_routing_paths_present.description: Whether the network topology contains paths where response traffic may return via a different physical or logical path than the request, such as ECMP routes or multi-homed interfaces without session affinity.

credential_scope_separation_enforced.title: Credential Scope Separation Enforced
credential_scope_separation_enforced.description: Whether boundary device credentials are stored and managed in a completely separate credential store from internal zone credentials, with no shared accounts, passwords, or derivable secrets.

shared_credential_identities_detected.title: Shared Credential Identities Detected
shared_credential_identities_detected.description: Whether any specific user accounts, service accounts, API keys, or SSH keys are confirmed to exist on both boundary devices and internal zone systems.

boundary_to_internal_mfa_required.title: MFA Required for Boundary-to-Internal Privilege Escalation
boundary_to_internal_mfa_required.description: Whether a separate MFA challenge is required when a session authenticated at the boundary layer attempts to access or manage internal zone resources.

shadowed_rule_count.title: Shadowed Firewall Rule Count
shadowed_rule_count.description: Number of firewall rules completely shadowed by earlier broader rules in the policy, making them unreachable and potentially masking intended allow/deny behavior.

stale_rule_count.title: Stale Firewall Rule Count
stale_rule_count.description: Number of firewall rules referencing IP ranges, hostnames, or service ports for decommissioned or no longer active services.

rule_review_age_days.title: Days Since Last Firewall/ACL Policy Review
rule_review_age_days.description: Number of days since the firewall ruleset or ACL was last formally reviewed and certified, indicating how outdated the policy may be.

automated_shadow_detection_enabled.title: Automated Shadow/Redundancy Detection Enabled
automated_shadow_detection_enabled.description: Indicates whether an automated tool or process is configured to continuously or periodically detect shadowed, redundant, or stale firewall rules and alert on findings.
